en.headline: Queen Elizabeth Hospital reports influenza A cluster among four patients
en.dek: Four women aged 60 to 75 in a medical ward tested positive after developing fever or respiratory symptoms since 20 November, with one in critical condition due to underlying illness.
body: Queen Elizabeth Hospital said on Tuesday that four patients in a female medical ward, aged 60 to 75, have presented with fever or respiratory symptoms since 20 November. Viral tests confirmed all four were positive for Influenza A.

The four patients are being treated in isolation. One is in critical condition because of her underlying illness, while the other three are in stable condition, the hospital said. Infection control measures have been stepped up according to established guidelines, and other patients in the ward are under close surveillance.
The cases have been reported to the Hospital Authority Head Office and the Centre for Health Protection for follow-up. The announcement was issued on behalf of the Hospital Authority.
Hong Kong remains in a flu season that began in late June. Health authorities have continued to urge vaccination for eligible people.

zh.headline: 伊利沙伯醫院內科女病房出現甲型流感個案組群
zh.dek: 四名60至75歲女病人自11月20日起出現發燒或呼吸道徵狀，檢測對甲型流感呈陽性，其中一人因自身疾病情況危殆。
body: 伊利沙伯醫院周二公布，一個內科女病房自11月20日起，先後有四名年齡介乎60至75歲的病人出現發燒或呼吸道感染徵狀。院方為病人進行病毒測試，結果均對甲型流感病毒呈陽性。
四名病人現時接受隔離治療。其中一名病人因自身疾病而情況危殆，其餘三名病人情況穩定。院方已按既定指引加強感染控制措施，並繼續監察病房其他病人。
有關個案已呈報醫院管理局總辦事處及衞生防護中心跟進。有關公布由醫院管理局代為發出。
本港自六月下旬進入流感季節至今。衞生當局持續呼籲合資格人士盡快接種流感疫苗。
